name: Run Python
summary: Runs Python from chat on this Mac, and draws turtle pictures.
author: Lasso

commands.title: Run Python
commands.howTo: Type **/run** to run the Python in the last reply, or **/run** and your code. It answers with what the code printed.

tool.name: run_python
tool.description: Run Python 3 code on this Mac in a sandbox (no internet, 20 s limit). Returns what it printed and any error.

commands.title: Draw with Python
commands.howTo: Type **/draw** after a reply with turtle code, or **/draw** and your code. The drawing opens as a picture.
